description.value: Dragon Bowl is a fast-casual Chinese restaurant chain with a Richmond outpost on No. 3 Road near Richmond Centre, serving customizable rice bowls, noodle bowls, protein-packed salads, and bubble tea made with natural ingredients. The location sits steps from Richmond-Brighouse SkyTrain and nearby shopping, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through central Richmond. The chain also offers corporate catering and a personalized meal-prep service for those planning ahead.
